Body.Content:
[Education]Microsoft Classroom is a new, standalone Microsoft 365 experience for teaching and learning, designed for primary, secondary and higher education.

It's a front door to familiar Microsoft education tools — Assignments, Classwork, Grades, OneNote Class Notebook, Learning Accelerators and Insights — in one place, and another option alongside Teams for Education and Microsoft 365 LTI. A personal Home shows educators and students what needs attention across their classes, while a shared Class Home, set up by the educator, gives every class a recognizable starting point.

More info: https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/educationblog/introducing-microsoft-classroom-a-new-experience-built-for-teaching-and-learning/4571185

GA date: June CY2027

Preview date: February CY2027
